name: LA-04
label: Safe R

key_factors: Mike Johnson is a well-funded incumbent Speaker in an R+17 district
Massive fundraising gap: $21M raised vs under $300K for Democrats
Prediction markets price Republican win at ~94%
No polling and no expert ratings; fundamentals dominate
model.rationale: Johnson holds a deep-red R+17 seat as a nationally prominent incumbent with a huge financial edge, and markets give Democrats only a ~4% chance. The baseline's Safe R call stands, with the margin nudged toward the district's partisan lean.
model.watch: Any major national scandal or wave environment could narrow the margin, though a Democratic win remains highly unlikely.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Louisiana's 4th District is a solidly Republican seat, and its incumbent, Mike Johnson, is running for reelection while serving as Speaker of the House. The district's partisan lean of R+17 leaves Democrats with little room, and no public polling or expert ratings suggest the race is competitive.

Johnson has raised roughly $21 million and holds $9.6 million on hand, dwarfing the combined fundraising of his Democratic challengers, who have about $270,000 each and minimal cash. Prediction markets price a Republican win at about 94 percent. The forecast is Safe R, with Johnson expected to win by a wide margin.
